why: Wiring cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/wiring-1.md) logged one P2 and one P3 `docs` finding. wiring-1.10: the generated docs print each arm of a union as a required prop and name no default: `docs/data-table.md` lists `virtual: VirtualLike`, `docs/use-data-table.md` lists `detail`, `docs/stat-card.md` lists both `href` and `onSelect`, and none states `phone`, `cardsBelow`, `pager` or `tier`; `docs/define-nav.md` and `docs/col.md` are a signature with no example and no kind list; `docs/table.md` has an empty `use when`. Two pages took seven `.d.ts` reads. wiring-1.14 (P3): `/basalt-app` links `docs/*.md` relative to its own dir, where nothing resolves; `docs/recipes/{app-shell,add-page}.md` show no imports and cite `apps/playground/src/routes/index.tsx`, which does not ship; README says `bunx basalt-ui init`, the skill says never a download-and-run; nothing says whether `Delta.value` 0.12 means 12 %.
what: The shipped docs answer a prop's required-ness, default and shape without a `.d.ts` read.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/scripts/gen-recipes.ts and the recipe regions it reads
the JSDoc of defineNav, col, StatCard, Delta and ui/table that gen-docs reads
change: `gen-docs.ts` renders a union prop as its arms ("either `href` or `onSelect`") and prints `@default` where the JSDoc has one; the `phone`, `cardsBelow`, `pager` and `tier` JSDoc gain theirs. `defineNav`, `col` (with its kinds) and `StatCard` each carry one `@example`; `ui/table` gets its `@useWhen` and `@neverWhen`; `Delta.value` says what a number means. Recipes print their imports and name no unshipped file. The skill links `node_modules/basalt-ui/docs/<name>.md` and says once how `init` is run.
commits: docs: or fix: in packages/basalt-ui as the release rules say.
acceptance: `docs/data-table.md`, `docs/use-data-table.md` and `docs/stat-card.md` show the union arms, and no arm as plainly required
`rg -n 'apps/playground' packages/basalt-ui/docs/recipes` is empty, and every link in `agent/skills/basalt-app/**` resolves from an installed app
